speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a history of recent sinusitis treated with antibiotics, along with current symptoms of fatigue, flank pain, and fever. Can you tell me exactly when the sinusitis was diagnosed and what specific antibiotic you took?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The combination of recent antibiotic use for sinusitis, followed by persistent fever, fatigue, and flank pain is highly suggestive of a secondary urinary tract infection that has ascended to the kidneys. Do you have burning sensation during urination or have you passed any stones?
